step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify all 8 nodes from the visual input and audio context: Bitbucket (ThirdParty), API Gateway (ApiGateway), Lambda (Lambda), initial source S3 bucket (S3), CodeBuild (CodeBuild), target artifact S3 bucket (S3), CodePipeline (CodePipeline), and CloudFormation (CloudFormation).
2. Differentiate the two S3 buckets as separate functional components in the pipeline: the first bucket stores zipped source artifacts from Lambda, while the second stores filtered, changed files generated by CodeBuild to avoid unnecessary pipeline triggers.
3. Identify edge connections and flow sequences from visual arrows: Bitbucket connects to API Gateway and Lambda. API Gateway triggers Lambda. Lambda writes zipped artifacts to the first S3 bucket. S3 triggers CodeBuild. CodeBuild processes changed files and writes them to the second S3 bucket. The second S3 bucket triggers CodePipeline, which applies CloudFormation change sets.

graph.name: CleverTap Automated Infrastructure Deployment Architecture
graph.notes: Automated cross-region infrastructure deployment pipeline ensuring 100% read-only access to AWS console.

nodes.name: BIT BUCKET
nodes.notes: Version control repository containing infrastructure code and PRs.

nodes.name: API GW
nodes.notes: Receives webhook triggers from Bitbucket repository changes.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Zips input artifacts required by CodeBuild.

nodes.name: CODEBUILD
nodes.notes: Downloads S3 contents, calculates checksums to detect changes, and isolates changed files.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores only modified files to prevent unnecessary pipeline execution.

nodes.name: CODEPIPELINE
nodes.notes: Orchestrates deployment stages and optional manual review steps.

nodes.name: CLOUDFORMATION
nodes.notes: Applies change sets to update infrastructure stacks across environments.

edges.notes: Bitbucket sends webhook event to API Gateway.
Direct event trigger or code metadata transfer to Lambda.
Lambda uploads zipped code artifact to S3.
Object creation in S3 triggers CodeBuild.
CodeBuild uploads detected changed files to second S3 bucket.
Updated files in S3 trigger CodePipeline.
CodePipeline executes CloudFormation change sets on infrastructure stacks.
